Renal

eGFR — CKD-EPI 2021 Creatinine

Estimate glomerular filtration rate using the CKD-EPI 2021 creatinine equation.

Result

Enter values to calculate

Formula

eGFR = 142 × min(Scr/κ, 1)^α × max(Scr/κ, 1)^-1.200 × 0.9938^Age × 1.012 [if female]

Clinical interpretation

  • ≥90: Normal or high
  • 60–89: Mildly decreased
  • 45–59: Mild to moderately decreased
  • 30–44: Moderately to severely decreased
  • 15–29: Severely decreased
  • <15: Kidney failure range

Use for adults 18 years and older. Interpretation depends on clinical context and chronicity.

References

  • CKD-EPI 2021 creatinine equation
